title: Join-pullback realization of a restricted simplex extension category
statement:
Use small simplicial sets, ordinary nerves, quasicategories and full subcategories of [def-cbc-enhanced-diagrams-cones], joins of [def-coef-infinity-relative-cone], and inner and left fibrations of [def-coef-infinity-fibrations]. Let $C,J$ be small ordinary categories, let $p:E\to N(C)$ be an inner fibration of quasicategories, let $d\geq0$, and let $\tau:\Delta^d\to E$. Let $g:\Delta^d\star N(J)\to N(C)$ restrict to $p\tau$ on $\Delta^d$. Form $V=E\times_{N(C)}(\Delta^d\star N(J))$, let $U\subseteq V$ be the inverse image of the terminal factor $N(J)$, and let $\bar\tau:\Delta^d\to V$ be the lift with coordinates $(\tau,\operatorname{id}_{\Delta^d})$. Define $E_{\tau/}$ in degree $k$ by extensions $\Delta^d\star\Delta^k\to E$ of $\tau$, with operators restricting the last block, and similarly define $N(C)_{p\tau/}$ and $V_{\bar\tau/}$. The map $g$ defines $\beta:N(J)\to N(C)_{p\tau/}$ by restriction along $\operatorname{id}_{\Delta^d}\star\sigma$ for each $\sigma:\Delta^k\to N(J)$. Put $L=E_{\tau/}\times_{N(C)_{p\tau/}}N(J)$, with projection $\rho:L\to N(J)$.

Then $V$ is a quasicategory, $U$ is a full subcategory of $V$, and $\bar\tau$ is nondegenerate with no vertex in $U$, whether or not $\tau$ or $p\tau$ is degenerate. There is a natural isomorphism of simplicial sets $L\cong V_{\bar\tau/}\times_VU$, compatible with evaluation of the terminal block and with the projection to $N(J)$. Under this isomorphism terminal evaluation $L\to U$ is a left fibration, and $L$ is a quasicategory. Restriction to the last vertex of $\Delta^d$ induces an isomorphism $N(C)_{p\tau/}\cong N(C)_{p\tau(d)/}$, taking $\beta$ to the map induced by $g|_{\{d\}\star N(J)}$. These assertions include $J=\varnothing$.
